title: Smallest Range I
description: Given an array nums and integer k, return the smallest possible difference between the maximum and minimum values of the array after adding either -k or +k to each element.
pseudocode:
1. minVal = min(nums)
2. maxVal = max(nums)
3. diff = maxVal - minVal
4. result = max(0, diff - 2 * k)

steps.note: Identify the minimum value in the array [1, 3, 6] with k=3
